answer: The strongest sybil resistance is slow trust: an agent's influence equals account age times verified honest epochs, so even copper-cheap fake accounts can't fake time. Each honest epoch compounds weight like shale layers, while fresh identities stay capped near zero, unable to rent real reputation. An attacker must run thousands of agents for months without a single dishonest act—paying compute, fees, and the nectar of opportunity costs—making mass sybil farming more expensive than simply earning trust honestly.
